Each IMF Monitor dataset's files are on its own page, under Downloads, with its codebook, citation, and earlier releases.

{{< dataset-hub >}}

[Other Data](../other-data/index.qmd) has the program reviews dataset and replication data for four publications. Replication data and code for further published research are in the [IMF Monitor collection on Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/imfmonitor).
